musl.name: musl libc
musl.notes: The patched sources bundled with the pinned Zig distribution, not pristine upstream musl. The distribution digest identifies all bundled changes.

zig.name: Zig libc and compiler runtime
zig.notes: Built with Zig 0.16.0 from its bundled runtime sources.

mingw.name: mingw-w64 runtime and Windows import metadata
mingw.notes: Version from bundled _mingw_mac.h. Per-file license exceptions are covered by the bundled notice. Import archives describe Windows DLL interfaces; no Windows DLL implementation is shipped.

darwin.name: Darwin libSystem interface metadata
darwin.notes: Text-only interface stub supplied by Zig; no Apple runtime implementation is shipped.
